correctness.rationale: Consecutive k+1 facets of the infinite-line neighborhood complex have boundary-of-k-simplex nerve; every further facet meets the prefix in a cone with explicit apex, giving S^(k-1). A k+2-facet nerve boundary identity shows translation acts by (-1)^k. The n>=4k+1 reduction is a graph two-covering, hence gives a covering of neighborhood complexes and the mapping torus of the n-step translate. The Wang sequence proves the exact integral groups, with separate k=2 overlap. The standalone verifier confirms essential local statements for k=2..7 and mod-prime samples, not used for the all-parameter inference.

value.rationale: The uniform proof supplies arbitrarily high-dimensional sphere-fiber mapping tori and detects exactly when higher-dimensional integral two-torsion appears. It simultaneously explains parity, dimensionality, and the torsion/non-torsion dichotomy by a geometric monodromy. This goes substantially beyond a routine finite computation or another fixed-power formula.
